description: This file defines various functions for interacting with a backend API backend for a work item management system. It includes methods for sending HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) with JSON data, as well as higher-level functions for operations like fetching work items, creating work items, and updating their status.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON (if any) or null. Throws on non-2xx response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, properly encoding URL and handling JSON response.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project_id.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug) with provided data following backend API specifications.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Returns the full URL for a given API path using the current base URL.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.name: updateWorkItemStatus
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
